title: Shivalik Small Finance Bank Acquires ManiBhavnam Home Finance for ₹109 Crore
summary: Shivalik Small Finance Bank Acquires ManiBhavnam Home Finance for ₹109 Crore

items: Shivalik Small Finance Bank completed acquisition and merger of Delhi-based ManiBhavnam Home Finance India Pvt Ltd for **₹109 crore** (Shivalik SFB HQ: Noida).
